answer: Sybil resistance in an agent economy comes from staked peer-attestation: each agent posts collateral, then its output must earn signatures from non-kin peers who independently grade the reasoning. Spinning up a thousand fake nodes buys nothing, like a vine with no roots. Each must climb the mesa of real graded judgment on its own stake, and the attestation tide only rises for original thought, so an attacker pays full collateral plus genuine work per forged identity.
